facts.text: The Exhibit Hall is presented for receptions and art exhibits. The Theater is presented for ballets, concerts, graduations and pageants. Dogwood 1 & 2 is a published combined room of 1,800 square feet; Dogwood 1, 2 & 3 is 2,880 square feet. The page separately lists AV/conference capabilities and staffing categories.

routes.suggestedReplacement: Compare an art-exhibit request for the Exhibit Hall with a presentation request asking staff to review Dogwood 1 & 2. Preserve layout, attendance, setup and AV needs in both inquiries. These are planning examples, not approved capacities or room recommendations.
limitations: No layout-specific approved attendance chart was found. Do not calculate capacities from dimensions, add attendance figures, or turn listed support services into inclusion promises.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Remove the internal consolidation instruction and demonstrate a bounded room/use comparison using verified facility facts or an explicitly fictional event request. Do not invent combined capacities or approvals.

facts.text: Processing requires an appointment. Animal arrival is the evening before the scheduled slaughter day or by 8 a.m. that day unless staff arrange otherwise. Customers call cutting instructions within 24 hours after drop-off. Staff later call when pickup is ready.

routes.suggestedReplacement: For a confirmed appointment, show drop-off first, the separate 24-hour phone-in instruction deadline next, and pickup only after the ready call. An appointment inquiry does not reserve a date.
limitations: No fixed completion or pickup deadline is published in this sequence. Do not infer one or provide handling advice.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Resolve the unfinished timing instruction with checked source details for drop-off and cut instructions, or a clearly fictional timeline that demonstrates the website design without asserting operator times. Keep pickup contingent on the ready call.

facts.text: Creek Ecology meets at the picnic shelter off Seckman Road and samples Rock Creek. Geology and Paleontology, Archaeology and virtual field trips are restricted to Mondays/Tuesdays. Specialized programs last 90 minutes and are encouraged for groups of 30 students or fewer. The standard hike may be replaced by an accessible indoor activity; the museum film can be unavailable when the auditorium hosts programming.
The linked shelter page supplies coordinates 38.379444, -90.395.

routes.suggestedReplacement: Name Creek Ecology’s shelter arrival point separately from museum visits. Put the Monday/Tuesday restriction on Geology and Paleontology and Archaeology cards, then ask staff to confirm date, group and any indoor alternative.
limitations: No exclusive weekday restriction for Creek Ecology is stated. The shelter coordinate is a published point, not independently verified bus routing.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Use checked official program facts to name the creek meeting point and at least one relevant program/day distinction. Replace unfinished obtain-directions wording; retain staff confirmation and conditional indoor alternative.

facts.text: Provided tents are removed November 1–April 14; platform sites may still be reserved but campers bring their own tent. Equestrian campers must have a horse. A current notice closes all camping October 30–November 1, 2026; the park closure runs from 3 p.m. October 30 until 7:30 a.m. November 2.

routes.suggestedReplacement: Label November 1–April 14 platform stays as bring-your-own-tent, subject to current notices and staff confirmation. Keep that equipment condition separate from equestrian eligibility and organized-group arrangements.
limitations: The dated managed-hunt closure overrides normal seasonal availability. Do not describe November 1, 2026 as an available example stay. No inventory or group exception was verified.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Check and name the published platform tent removal period or demonstrate an explicitly fictional before/after-season inquiry. Keep current status confirmation and do not invent inventory or group eligibility.

facts.text: A child may apply from age five. For ages 5–17, a parent or legal guardian signs in front of library staff and assumes responsibility for materials. Under-fives use a parent’s card. Identity/address evidence remains required; out-of-county property taxpayers additionally provide a tax receipt.

routes.suggestedReplacement: For a child aged 5–17, identify the parent/legal guardian’s in-person signature step. A filled form or online question does not complete that step. Keep the appropriate adult applicant checklist alongside it.
limitations: Library staff make eligibility decisions. Do not request document uploads or imply that an ordinary parent message substitutes for the witnessed signature.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Resolve the exact child-age/in-person-signature rule from the official source and rewrite the unfinished publication sentence. Preserve category-specific checklists and staff authority; do not collect identity documents.

facts.text: Walk-in tickets are sold at the Interpretive Center or Museum Gallery. Admission lasts two days and covers the Interpretive Center, Museum Gallery, Mark Twain Boyhood Home, Huckleberry Finn House, Becky Thatcher House, Justice of the Peace Office and Grant’s Drug Store. Tours are self-guided; guided groups cost extra. Boyhood Home and Grant’s Drug Store have stair-related limitations and video alternatives.
The Interpretive Center is at 415 North Main Street; Museum Gallery is at 120 North Main Street, Hannibal.
Directions explicitly recommend beginning at the Interpretive Center.

routes.suggestedReplacement: List both ticket-purchase points, mark the Interpretive Center as the recommended start, and show the seven included stops. A visitor can return on day two; route and access planning should identify specific buildings.
limitations: Do not describe both buildings as equally recommended starts. The online map contains nine points including a shop and statue; it is not the seven-building admission list. Guided extras and nearby attractions remain separate.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Check and name the two ticket-purchase/start locations and demonstrate the itinerary distinction with verified included buildings. Keep access-specific details and guided extras separate; do not invent coverage.

facts.text: Daily Tours are guided, approximately one hour and open to all ages. A 20-or-more paid-participant group-rate arrangement uses a phone booking; that threshold is not a minimum party size for ordinary visits.
Black Light Tour is approximately one hour, excludes children under eight, and requires online purchase at least three hours ahead. This is a guided fluorescence tour in a darkened cave.

Bootlegger’s Bequest is a 60-minute escape game, not a cave tour. Its overview specifies a private party of 4–10 and participants aged ten or older. The same page’s age FAQ welcomes all ages and discusses younger players, creating a conflict. That FAQ also requires adult accompaniment below sixteen. Booking must be online in advance; no numeric cutoff appears.
The rates page independently names Bootlegger’s Bequest Escape Room and the 4–10-player flat-rate structure.

Ozark Howler Ghost Walk is a separate limited-date folklore experience. Its page lists Friday/Saturday October 9–31, 5:30–7:30 p.m., advance tickets and unsuitability below seven. Do not use it as the source for Black Light or Escape Room requirements.

routes.suggestedReplacement: Compare Daily Tours, Black Light Tour and Bootlegger’s Bequest by their own conditions. A seven-year-old does not meet the Black Light rule; a three-person party falls below the escape-game range. Describe the escape overview as listing ages ten-plus, and send younger-player questions to the operator because its FAQ differs.
limitations: The escape-room under-ten exception remains unresolved; do not promise acceptance or present an exception as an established rule.
No numeric escape-room lead time was found. Say advance online booking; do not copy Black Light’s three-hour cutoff.
The booking destination linked from Escape Room could not be retrieved by the web tool after redirect. No live availability or checkout validation was performed.
Ozark Howler date text omits a year. Do not turn it into an evergreen schedule; current bookings need confirmation.
requiredFixesFromAudit: Recheck official current experience pages and align the named options, age/party limits and advance arrangement requirements with the actual sources. Replace unfinished publication language with a demonstrated comparison; retain staff confirmation.
